scope: All units read: translation and word glosses against the Telugu text. The text was not compared with the source.

items.issue: భద్రాచల వర is “Lord of Bhadrācala”; the translation had “Rāmadāsa of Bhadrācala” and an added “O excellent Rāma”.
items.change: Now “O Lord of Bhadrācala, sustainer of Rāmadāsa”.
